structure: Part 3 read e2e/consignment-parties.fit.spec.js (398 lines) and e2e/support/journey.js (270 lines) in full. The spec has 14 tests in four describe blocks: 'consignment addresses' (7: cattle five roles plus CPH, cat permanent address replacing CPH, picking every role then the CPH number, same-as shortcuts, picker search, continue with nothing chosen, save and return to hub), 'add an address from the journey' (2: place of origin international by hand, consignee UK lookup), 'add-address pages for the other roles' (1: consignor, importer, place of destination), 'permanent address' (2: per-animal choice and its errors, retired enter-address redirect) and 'contact address for consignment' (2: choice and error, add a new branch address). A shared toRoles helper starts a live-animals notification, answers origin, commodity (cattle x1 or cat x2), reason and consignment details, then goes to /roles-and-addresses by URL. Pages covered, all under /design-release-2.1: /roles-and-addresses, the five pickers (/place-of-origin, /consignor-or-exporter, /consignee, /importer, /place-of-destination), their /add-address pages, /cph-number, /permanent-address, /permanent-address/select, /permanent-address/enter-address, /contact-address-for-consignment, with exits to /notification-hub, /review-notification and /address-book/add/lookup. From journey.js only the helpers these tests call are claimed: the base path, the action button values, the error summary title, the CORE_ADDRESSES fixture ids, chooseAddress, fillCph and answerContactAddress. Claims p3-001 to p3-110 keep the ids of an earlier extract of this same slice (the spec is unchanged since); p3-111 to p3-113 are new.

claims.statement: The 'add a new branch address' link on the contact address page opens the address book's add-address lookup (/address-book/add/lookup).

await page.locator('main').getByRole('link', { name: 'add a new branch address' }).click()
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/address-book\/add\/lookup/)
claims.note: The URL check is a loose regex, so it does not prove whether the address book page is inside the /design-release-2.1 mount, or that the user is brought back to the contact page afterwards.

claims.statement: Every error summary in this part has the title 'There is a problem'.
claims.quote: await expect(summary.locator('.govuk-error-summary__title')).toHaveText('There is a problem')

claims.statement: The suite asserts no validation error for the CPH number: no test covers a non-numeric or wrongly sized county, parish or holding number.
claims.note: Only a partial answer (silently not stored) and a full valid answer are tested.

claims.statement: The suite asserts no format validation for the email address or phone number on the add-address page or the per-animal permanent address form.
claims.note: Only the 'Enter ...' blank-field errors are asserted.

claims.statement: The suite does not show what a successful per-animal 'Enter a new address' saves or displays on the roles page.
The suite does not exercise 'Save and return to hub' on the CPH number, permanent address or contact address pages, nor 'Save and select' on a manual (place of origin or consignor) add-address page.
The suite does not say what happens when /permanent-address is visited for a non-pet (cattle) consignment, the counterpart of the CPH redirect for pets.
The suite does not assert where each 'Change' link on the completed roles page leads, nor which roles carry the 'Same as place of origin' and 'Same as consignee' buttons.
The suite does not test the roles page with a pig consignment, though the file states the CPH number applies to cattle and pigs.

The contact address options are branch addresses of the user's organisations: one organisation can appear with more than one branch, each with its own value (such as aberdeen-livestock-harbour-road and aberdeen-livestock-union-street).
claims.quote: await page.locator('input[name="contactAddressId"][value="aberdeen-livestock-harbour-road"]').check()
claims.note: The spec checks the value aberdeen-livestock-harbour-road while the shared helper defaults to aberdeen-livestock-union-street; the radio labels show only the organisation name, so two Aberdeen Livestock Ltd branches are inferred from the two values.

claims.statement: The suite asserts no back link on the contact address page, unlike every other page in this part.
The suite does not show which role the address saved with 'Save and select' on the consignee add-address page is assigned to: it asserts only the return to /roles-and-addresses with no error.
